notes.title: New patch: Stability & bug fixing
notes.notes:
Hi players,

A new patch for EDENGATE: The Edge of Life is now available for download, which includes bug fixing and additional improvements.

Here’s the changelog:


General stability improvements
Framerate capped at 120 fps
Crash fix leaving Gallery

Thank you for your patience and your feedback!

HOOK Team

notes.title: New Release date: 15th November 2022
notes.notes:
Hi players,

To give you the best experience possible in EDENGATE: The Edge of life, we have decided to slightly postpone the release of the game to November 15th, 2022. These two additional weeks will allow our small dev team to polish all the necessary details.

Soon you will be able to explore and discover all the secrets that lie behind Mia's story.
